name: cfg-project-sdk-sources-invalid
about: settingSources 指到的配置文件内容不合法时（sdkSessionSettings.ts:160-190）：本地层根不是对象 → SDK_SETTING_SOURCE_INVALID；本地层 agent 不是对象 → INVALID_SDK_SETTINGS；本地层 agent.maxOutputTokens 不是正数；文件不存在时按空处理。比较各轮的错误事件。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  subagents:
    timeoutMs: 600000
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        proj:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        local:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
